name: io.github.nvdigitalsolutions/nvoos-astro-forge
title: NV oOS Astro Forge
description: MCP-driven generation of headless Astro frontends for WordPress/WooCommerce sites: analyze, scaffold, theme, deploy, and rebuild — the Proposal 096 tool surface.

environmentVariables.name: NVOOS_FORGE_MCP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token required for write tools (site_add, scaffold_project, deploy, wizard…). Unset = writes fail closed.

environmentVariables.name: NVOOS_FORGE_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Forge home directory (sites registry, vault, profiles). Default ~/.nvoos-forge

environmentVariables.name: NVOOS_FORGE_VAULT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Vault encryption passphrase for stored credentials (GitHub tokens, webhook secrets)

environmentVariables.name: NVOOS_FORGE_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Tool surface: router (3 meta-tools) or full (the whole catalog). Default full.

environmentVariables.name: NVOOS_FORGE_OPEN_ANALYZE
environmentVariables.description: Opt-in: allow site_analyze on URLs outside the registered allowlist (SSRF guard still applies)
